blurb: Beaumont Family Estate Winery is a certified organic winery established in 1995. They grow various grape varieties suited to the West Kelowna area and produce small batch wines. They offer a wine club with shipments of selected wines and host weddings for groups from 50 to 80 guests.
extraNote: No enrollment or cancellation fee for wine club · Memberships require a one year (3 shipment) commitment · Members commit to three orders, cancellation by email 30 days prior to next shipment · Each shipment charged separately one week prior to shipping date · Shipping across Canada with flat rate per province; extra fees for rural areas; no P.O. boxes · Members must update address, email and credit card information
